description: This file defines a PHP class 'File' responsible for managing session data using the filesystem in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for reading, writing, destroying session files, and garbage collection of expired sessions.
published: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Library	extbackslash Session	extbackslash File

classes.name: File
classes.description: Handles session management by reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session file handler with configuration retrieved from the registry.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from a file based on session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to a file with the specified session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file associated with the given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to delete expired session files based on configuration.
